name: Weighted Hanging Leg Raise
steps: Hang from the bar with an overhand grip and have a partner help position the dumbbell securely between your feet.
Engage your lats lightly and brace your abs to stop your body from swinging.
Keep your knees slightly bent and lift your legs in front of you, curling your pelvis toward your ribs without swinging.
Lower to a steady hang and have the partner take the dumbbell before you release the bar.
tips: Start with a light dumbbell you can grip securely between your feet without risking dropping it.
Avoid swinging your torso backward to throw the weight upward.
